changes: No substantive changes; added a note that the name ending in -masya could also be a title such as ...śarma(n) misinflected, so the owner's name cannot be recovered.

notes: The owner's name is lost in a lacuna and only the genitive ending -masya survives. It could be a name such as Rāma, or a misinflected title such as -śarma(n). Śiromaṇi is the usual name for Raghunātha Śiromaṇi, the Navya-Nyāya author of the Nañvāda. The colophon gives no date, scribe or place.
